coverage._note: Report-only baseline (CCS-019). Refresh from the coverage-rust / coverage-frontend CI artifacts (summary-by-dir.json) or locally: `cargo llvm-cov --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --lcov --output-path coverage/rust/lcov.info` and `pnpm test:coverage`, then `node scripts/coverage-summary.mjs`. P5 target: proxy/ and database/ lines >= 75%, ratcheted.

frontend.tool: vitest 2.1.9 + @vitest/coverage-v8 (include: src/**/*.{ts,tsx}, default excludes so colocated src tests are not counted)

proxy_e2e.scenario: non-streaming Claude /v1/messages, single provider, usage logging on
proxy_e2e._note: Proxy e2e baseline (CCS-014), measured by tests/proxy_e2e.rs::perf_baseline_non_streaming_request. Refresh with `CC_SWITCH_UPDATE_PERF_BASELINE=1 cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --test proxy_e2e perf_baseline`, then `npx prettier --write docs/dev/perf-baseline.json`. Gates: db_reads_per_request must be 0 (runtime config snapshot, CCS-124); db_statements_per_request must not grow; allocations_per_request may not exceed 3x. Latency is informational.
